task: Port existing bounded memory, identity-motion prediction and candidate/risk selection to the supplied module-free CADTrack baseline, then train on server2028 GPU2,3

adaptation.A: Reuse InstanceMemory: protected initial anchor, two target / non-target / unknown slots per sensor; ROI evidence; causal discriminative-margin preservation
adaptation.B: Reuse IdentityMotion: eight causal geometric states, three motion modes, three future-frame horizon; local-only absence / extra-region value prediction, at most one extra visual region online
adaptation.C: CAD-specific newly trained current quality / relative IoU advantage / localization risk / geometry acceptance, with candidate relations and independent RGB/TIR template commits
adaptation.scope_note: Initial native adaptation; C1 weights and GOLA-specific counterfactual action labels are not transplanted. Current-region supervised advantage is not represented as learned long-horizon action utility or exact old-policy equivalence. Memory sensor gates classify identity support, not separately annotated sensor reliability.

training: Real raw-video causal clips from all881 training sequences, eight predicted transitions per clip (exercising full motion history and template update), first clip box as initialization, all subsequent crop/state/history updates use model outputs. GT/future annotations used only in losses. 98 disjoint development sequences; official245-sequence test never enters training.
